verdict.rationale: The official, maintained Smithery CLI documents only the consumption side of the story: connecting agents to registry servers (smithery mcp add/list/remove) and calling tools. Publishing is documented only as a web URL flow, and the shutdown notice says the service-tied CLI versions stopped working. missing for 10: CLI authentication/login command, CLI build or stage of a server, CLI publish/push to the registry or deployment, and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents

citations.quote: Smithery CLI connects your agents to thousands of skills and MCP servers directly from the command line.
